_comment: Scoring rules shared by the workout matcher's two implementations: src/workout_matcher.py (server, used by webhook and iOS imports) and frontend/src/lib/workoutMatcher.ts (browser). Both read this file so the thresholds cannot drift apart. Parity is asserted by test_workout_matcher.py and frontend/src/lib/workoutMatcher.test.ts against data/matcher_fixtures.json.
